# mql-language-server

> Language Server Protocol implementation for MQL4 and MQL5 (MetaTrader 4/5), providing diagnostics, completion, hover, go-to-definition, references, rename, and workspace indexing. Published on nuget.org (`mql-language-server`, stable 2.4.0; command `mql-lsp-server`) and as standalone binaries for Linux/macOS/Windows x64+ARM64; local install also supported. Releases publish via GitHub Actions with NuGet Trusted Publishing (OIDC). Licensed under MIT.

## Architecture notes

- Source layout: `src/Lsp/Handlers` (one handler per LSP feature), `src/Lsp/Server` (middleware, path security, symbol index), `src/Parser` (shared parser services incl. `IncludePathResolver`, `ParseInputGuard`, `MacroExtractor`), `src/Mql4/Grammar` and `src/Mql5/Grammar` (ANTLR grammars `Mql4Grammar.g4` / `Mql5Grammar.g4` with generated parsers in `src/Parser/Generated`).
- Tests mirror source under `tests/` (1192 tests, `dotnet test`); `tests/FpMeasurement/` and `tests/Performance/` are category-excluded from normal CI runs.
- Workspace path containment: all client-supplied `file://` reads are validated against declared workspace folders (`PathSecurity`), and path resolution fails closed on symlink-resolution failure.
- Parse guards: a linear pre-scan caps bracket nesting depth and input size before ANTLR recursion, so deeply nested input cannot cause a non-catchable `StackOverflowException` in the LSP process.
